_comment: Human review decisions for data/processed/review_queue.json items of type same_name_different_vendor.
A decision only ALLOWS a merge that the automatic vendor rule held back; it never adds or changes a value.
Every decision must say what evidence was checked.

same_tool.reason: Wikipedia's List of HDL simulators names the author (Tristan Gingold); GitHub names the organisation (ghdl). The list row links ghdl.free.fr, and the GitHub repository ghdl/ghdl is the same VHDL simulator.

Wikipedia names the developer (Sandia National Laboratories); GitHub names the organisation account (Xyce). github.com/Xyce/Xyce is Sandia's official Xyce repository, the same SPICE-compatible simulator.
